items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: We had Marion Souter on trumpet.

ctx.x: We had Marion Souter on trumpet. I think Red Bowman, I think they had two trumpets. I think we had Shilang on drums again. Von Gammon played drums in Viberhop. What do you call the name of him? Bill Wiley, Bill Wiley I think played guitar. He's not too well known, but he was more of a vocalist, I think.
That's not Henry Wiley's brother, huh?
